requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Start with Memot"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Memot is a note app that can consolidate text, tables, and images into one."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This guide will explain using the examples of Public Relations Yamanashi-san and Sales Takanasai-san."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "We call short notes accompanying a page 'Quick Note'."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yamashiri-san leaves the decisions of the meeting in one Quick Note."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Yamashiri-san sticks sticky notes on important sections as a marker."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "One page can add up to ten items."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "For use by the team"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Kotori Yu's sales team first created a workspace."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Within the workspace, a location visible to everyone is called 'hiroba' (Commons)."} ]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Anyone can post notes to the Hiroba."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Kojiyayu-san shares his sales schedule with the team every morning on the Hiroba."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can invite team members by email to the workspace."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The invited people will receive a confirmation email."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Once the administrator approves, you can join immediately."}, {"id": 1, "text": "The member's permissions can also be changed for each group."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Sync and history"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Notes are automatically saved and synchronized across all devices."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can edit them offline and they sync immediately when you connect."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You can revert to a previous state from the page history."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tsukimi-ri-san was able to recover the text she accidentally deleted."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Tips for organizing"}, {"id": 1, "text": "It's convenient to pin important pages."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Pinned pages appear at the top of the list."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The notes in the Hiroba are easier to find if you add tags."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You can create tags freely ◆"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Kotori Yoyoi is dividing tags by project."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Even a single word can use the same tag."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "In the search, you can search for both the platform and the individual word simultaneously."},{"id": 1, "text": "If you cannot find it, please broaden the search range."}]}
